column1: # Shipped demo Port Labels (descriptive only: tags help search, they filter nothing).

# Ports: one token per row | 22 (TCP implied) | ranges 5900-5903 | udp:161 | udp:5405-5412
# Sources: vendor documentation, IETF RFCs and the IANA registry only (never nmap-services).
# Rows named "<Service> — common alternate port" are convention, not vendor-documented.
#   admin          management interface or protocol (SSH, RDP, web console, API)
#   oob            out-of-band controller (BMC: iLO, iDRAC, IPMI, XCC, CIMC)
#   backup         backup software and data movers
#   directory      AD, LDAP, Kerberos, DNS, authentication (RADIUS, TACACS+)
#   network        network device and routing/infrastructure protocols
#   devops         CI/CD, orchestration, containers, configuration management
#   file           file transfer, file sharing, storage, printing
